content: What's wrong with you? Why do you look so sad?
I've lost all my files from the computer. It's a total disaster.
Three days ago, my laptop went on strike. I couldn't enter the Windows system. As I was about to give it up, one of my friends advised me to start Windows in the safe mode.

Was it helpful?

What a pity!

That's such a big loss.
Perhaps I should be blamed for simply taking it for granted that the digital will always be in safe hands. I've neglected the potential risk of losing it.
Don't blame yourself. We all make the same mistake. The digital information we all rely on is actually very fragile.
